mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_PERSON (ID, EXTERNAL_ID, NAME, GENDER, ORGANIZATION, OCCUPATION, ADDRESS, REMARK, SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, DELETED_FLAG, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{externalId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{organization}, #{occupation}, #{address}, #{remark}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PT_PERSON P WHERE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.ID, P.EXTERNAL_ID, P.NAME, P.GENDER, P.ORGANIZATION, P.OCCUPATION, P.ADDRESS, P.REMARK, P.SOURCE_UPDATED_AT, P.DELETED_FLAG AS DELETED, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.UPDATED_AT DESC, P.ID) AS RN FROM PT_PERSON P WHERE ) PAGE_DATA WHERE PAGE_DATA.RN > #{offset} AND PAGE_DATA.RN <= #{endRow} ORDER BY PAGE_DATA.RN
